description: This file contains shell functions for upgrading and preparing failure handling on Zyxel devices, specifically managing MTD partition checks, environment setup, and boot configurations.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios during environment check, unmounts all filesystems and reboots.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the system for upgrade by verifying MTD partitions, checking boot configuration, and setting the boot environment to facilitate the upgrade process.
